d:
Riot police surrounded Poland's Constitutional Tribunal in Warsaw after a government-backed judge announced she had suspended the court's chief justice, Bogdan Święczkowski. The court called it a "coup d'etat," and President Karol Nawrocki ordered his plane to turn back mid-flight to Senegal.
So what exactly happened at the tribunal, why has this court become the centre of a bitter fight between Nawrocki and Prime Minister Donald Tusk?
